module.name: EKS Cluster TMM Host-Device Dataplane
module.description: Prepares the host-device TMM data plane (awsbnkctl phase16/17/17c/20): labels the single role=bnk TMM node, assigns SelfIP <subnet>.240 to each tagged secondary ENI, runs an iface-discovery probe (MAC->ifname->PCI) before any TMM pod exists, and applies host-device NADs (external-netdevice/internal-netdevice, pciBusID) in f5-cne-system + default. Surfaces ifname/PCI/SelfIP/AZ for cneinstall. Multus install is handled by the cloud-agnostic eks-cluster-install-multus module (depends on it via multus_ready).

required.reason: Multus must be installed and the NetworkAttachmentDefinition CRD Established before host-device NADs are applied.
Provides the single role=bnk TMM node + the tagged secondary ENIs (f5-bnk:tmm-role) this module discovers and binds.

optional.reason: Owns nad_namespace (f5-cne-system); must exist before the NADs are applied there.

optional.name: eks_cluster_name
optional.description: EKS cluster name — used to refresh an exec-auth kubeconfig (aws eks update-kubeconfig).

optional.name: nad_namespace
optional.description: Namespace for the NADs — MUST match the CNEInstance namespace. Gold-standard split: f5-cne-system.

optional.name: selfip_host_offset
optional.description: Host octet for the TMM SelfIP within each /24 TMM subnet (awsbnkctl uses .240).

optional.name: skip_iface_discovery
optional.description: Skip the privileged iface-discovery pod and use the deterministic device-index PCI fallback.

key_outputs.name: nads_applied
key_outputs.description: Gate output: SelfIPs assigned + both host-device NADs applied.

key_outputs.name: external_pci
key_outputs.description: External ENI PCI bus id (CNEInstance PCIDEVICE env + host-device NAD).

key_outputs.name: external_selfip
key_outputs.description: External TMM SelfIP (<subnet>.240) for the ext-vlan F5SPKVlan.

key_outputs.name: internal_selfip
key_outputs.description: Internal TMM SelfIP for the int-vlan F5SPKVlan.

key_outputs.name: tmm_az
key_outputs.description: AZ of the single TMM node (scopes single-AZ cloud-network-mapping).
